text:
maya: nimble-1.2b int4 bringup — want a quick alignment on promptset curation + golden set before we run the canary tonight. who can take ownership of dedupe, golden, and labeler slots?
josh: tonight as in deploy-window 22:00? main risk I'm worried about is hallucination drift on multi-turn QA. also tokenization for code snippets.
li: i'll own the quant smoke bench (latency/cpu/kv behavior). recommend we run two slices: long-context QA and short codegen. need the exact promptset version to pin.
sam: promptset v12 (branch: promptbank/v12) has the recent paraphrase additions — dedupe run still pending. flagged ~2k suspected duplicates in longform slice.
maya: ok, thanks. for golden we should carve a compact set (~200) covering: hallucination, factuality, code correctness, math, multi-turn state. volunteers?
alex: I can assemble the golden candidates. prefer reusing the micro-golden from last qbench but expanded to include code multi-turn. linking the old list for reference: https://redwood.internal/docs/micro-golden-v2
eval-bot: automated-eval: scheduled job nimble-smoke-4105 queued (depends on promptset v12 dedupe pass).
sara: labeler capacity FYI — two SMEs free this afternoon, but bulk labeling will be delayed until tomorrow. can we reduce manual workload by prefiltering?
sam: plan: run automated fingerprint dedupe -> take top 150 high-entropy examples per slice -> manual review to final ~250. that keeps label effort ~3-4 hours per SME.
josh: for dedupe use fingerprint v2.0 script i pushed earlier: `scripts/dedupe.py --thresh 0.85 --keep-shorter --slot longform` — it preserved canonical context ordering last time.
li: bench config i'll run (quick snippet):
```
model: nimble-1.2b-int4
slices: [longform_qa, code_short]
seq_len: 2048
batching: auto
metrics: [ppl, med_lat, kv-miss-rate]
```
please don't change templates after this commit.
maya: timeline proposal: today EOD — dedupe pass and quant smoke. tomorrow 09:00AM — golden labeling complete + small canary (50 reqs per slice). rollout predicate: if quality regressions (factuality errors or incorrect code outputs) >5% on golden, rollback. ok?
ajex? (typo)
alex: +1. one more: pin prompt templates via checksum in the canary config so any change invalidates the run. add `prompt_checksum` to the canary manifest.
sara: added 4 labeling tasks to queue (labels: code/math/hallucination/multi-turn). ETA ~36h if no higher priority intervenes.
josh: i'll spin up bench infra and share logs to `/tmp/nimble-canary-4105.log` and post results in this thread. plan to capture raw generations + model kv sizes.
maya: i'll open a tracking issue: https://redwood.internal/track/PROD-4392 and assign tasks (dedupe: sam, bench: li/josh, golden: alex, labeling: sara).
li: FYI for the bench: include a small adversarial subset (10 examples) with tricky tokenization and long code blocks — helps catch broken tokenizer/quant combos.
sam: noted, i'll flag those in the prefilter. also will export a CSV of dedupe decisions for audit.
josh: all :thumbsup: from me. starting dedupe in ~10m.
eval-bot: automated-eval: nimble-smoke-4105 started. collecting metrics.
maya: great. please ping here with any showstoppers. if labelers are overloaded we can reduce canary volume and extend the observation window.
alex: prefer to keep canary small but diverse. i'll draft golden candidate list and push to `promptbank/v12/golden/` in ~2h.
sara: will prioritize the code slice first.
maya: thanks team — i'll update the tracking issue and follow up tomorrow AM with status.
